v2_architecture_goals: Preserve the frozen v1 local operator release (commit 7ef8ffd, tag pair FREEZE).
Keep the default local-only posture (MEDAI_LOCAL_ONLY=1, MEDAI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_API=0, MEDAI_REQUIRE_PII_SCRUB=1, MEDAI_PRIVACY_AUDIT=1).
Preserve the human-in-the-loop review boundary for every emitted result.
Preserve the no-silent-auto-accept rule: accepted_count and auto_accept_allowed_count remain workflow tallies, not clinical acceptance counts.
Preserve the no-external-API-by-default rule for runtime.
Preserve the private/licensed terminology gates established by PARK-02 and the prior TERM chain.
Keep cue expansion disallowed unless a future approved SPEC reverses it explicitly.
Separate runtime pipeline, operator UI, terminology, validation, storage, observability, and deployment into independently gated workstreams.
Require a parking snapshot (commit + two annotated tags) after each high-risk track.
Require public-safe reports only; aggregate-only outputs; no row content, no license text, no private paths, no PHI, no secrets.

v2_architecture_layers.v2_intent_summary: Carry forward the v1 ingestion contract; tighten the source-quarantine boundary so private filesystem paths never appear in public outputs.
Treat extraction adapters as replaceable contracts; isolate confidence/fallback decisions behind interface seams; never change routing inside any non-SPEC SPEC block.
Classifier remains review-bound. The residual-Unknown track stays parked at PARK-20..23 unless a fresh operator-UAT signal forces reopening.
Future work only. No clinical inference by default. No implementation in this SPEC.

v2_architecture_layers.v2_intent_summary: Carry forward the parked helper/wiring mini-track (PARK-01, e398a75) and the parked license-gated private adapter track (PARK-02, b9b19ad). Reopen only after concrete operator license confirmations land.

concerns: DDI boundary parked unless separately scoped
v2_architecture_layers.v2_intent_summary: Refusal rules are explicit, observable, and tested. Diagnosis / treatment / DDI logic remains parked unless a separate approved SPEC reopens them under named conditions.

UI shell remains read-only by default; Advanced technical details emit only controlled-vocabulary markdown and captions. Any new UI behavior must be opt-in, env-gated, default-off, mirroring DIAG-17/18/19 pattern.
Treat DB as a private store; never inspect rows; metadata-only diagnostics. Migrations require a dedicated SPEC and rollback plan before any block touches the schema.
Carry the v1 five-validation health-check set into v2 unchanged. Add a v2 validation matrix only when each new v2 block lands; never merge new validation steps into an existing v1 receipt.

Local launcher and packaging hardening continue under the existing PACKAGING-LAUNCHER-HARDEN and PACKAGING-DEPLOYMENT-POLISH series. No production deployment automation in v2 without a separate approved SPEC.

any block would touch a parked / frozen tag

parking_strategy.rule_1: Every high-risk track ends with a parking snapshot: one named commit + two annotated tags ({track}-ready-{date} and medai-final-parked-post-{track}-{date}).
parking_strategy.rule_2: Parking tags are pushed via github-direct (the local proxy historically 403s on refs/tags/* writes). Use the gh-installed credentials.
parking_strategy.rule_3: Never use git push --tags. Never use --force / --force-with-lease. Tag pushes are explicit by name.
parking_strategy.rule_4: Existing parking tags (PARK-20..26, FREEZE, term helper/wiring PARK-01, license-gate PARK-02) must remain unchanged across every subsequent block.
parking_strategy.rule_5: A parking block is reports-only by definition. It records the matrix, blocks the implementation, and adds the two annotated tags.
parking_strategy.rule_6: Any reopening of a parked track requires a fresh SPEC block first; reopening must not move or repoint existing parking tags.
